row.proto: void *Game_DriverContracts_CollectTeamsInScoreRange(void *comp, void *out, uint32_t driverId, uint32_t skipTeamId, int minScore, int maxScore, void *teamVec, uint8_t useSecondList)
row.notes: Looks up the driver's exclusion record (comp+0x3c8..+0x3d0, stride 0x48). For each team pointer in teamVec skips skipTeamId, teams in the record list +0x10 and (if useSecondList) teams in list +0x30, then scores the team with func 0x1407c4610(comp+0x398, owner, teamId, season) and appends {teamId, score} (8 bytes) to out when the score is valid and within [minScore, maxScore]. Good hook to widen which teams can offer contracts.
